name: Robert Gomez
source:
From: Mobile Suit V Gundam
An Earth Federation Forces Lieutenant ordered to provide planetside transport for the League Militaire. He then joined the League Mitaire, going up to space in an old EFF battleship, the Reinforce, and would eventually captain the remodeled version of that ship, the Reinforce Jr.
